ModMetaData.name: Dagmay — Mosaic 0.2 Pre-Alpha
ModMetaData.author: Mosaic Project
ModMetaData.description: Version 0.2-prealpha of Mosaic for RimWorld, retaining the historical Dagmay package ID and code namespaces for compatibility. This checkpoint preserves the recovered Observer-only 0.1 closure foundation and adds portable temporal facts, environment-binding separation, pure appraisal contracts, external-event admission, action-origin attribution, behavior-influence provenance, lifecycle-bearing story threads, milestone progress, evidence-grounded read-only presentation contracts, and fail-closed persistence-manifest validation. It adds no pawn control or direct LLM job issuance. Static verification, 67 contract tests, six default integration scenarios, an opt-in deterministic Gate 3 offline soak, and compilation against RimWorld 1.6 assemblies pass. RimWorld in-game runtime and save compatibility remain unverified.
